# Falcon Drone v2 — Product Specification

## Overview

The Falcon Drone v2 is Aurora Robotics' second-generation industrial inspection drone, launched in the fourth quarter of 2022. It builds on the original Falcon Drone platform with a substantially longer flight time, higher payload capacity, and an integrated LIDAR sensor developed from Aurora Robotics' 2022 acquisition of SkyMetrics.

## Flight Performance

The Falcon Drone v2 has a maximum flight time of 52 minutes on a single battery charge, a significant improvement over the v1's 35-minute flight time. Operational range has also increased to 8 kilometers from the ground control station. The swappable lithium-ion battery pack now recharges in approximately 30 minutes, down from 45 minutes on the v1.

## Payload and Sensors

The Falcon Drone v2 supports a maximum payload capacity of 4 kilograms, up from 2.5 kilograms on the v1. The standard sensor package now includes a 20-megapixel camera along with an integrated LIDAR sensor for high-precision 3D mapping, eliminating the need for a separate thermal add-on module in most inspection scenarios.

## New Capabilities

The Falcon Drone v2 introduces autonomous obstacle avoidance, allowing the drone to detect and navigate around unexpected obstacles such as construction equipment or wildlife without operator intervention. This feature was a key requirement for expanding into construction site inspection.

## Primary Use Case

While the Falcon Drone v1 was focused primarily on pipeline inspection, the Falcon Drone v2's expanded payload and sensor capability allow it to serve agricultural inspection and construction site inspection customers in addition to the original utility infrastructure use case.

## Firmware Note

Falcon Drone v2 units in the field receive periodic over-the-air firmware updates. Following the November 2023 firmware incident, all firmware updates now go through a staged rollout process with mandatory hardware-in-the-loop testing before release to the full fleet.
